items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Stan Musiel playing then? [INTERVIEWEE] No, Stanley was not playing then.

ctx.x: Yeah. I joined Merv in about ‘65. I left Woody in the World Series ‘64. Cardinals- Yankees, Reno, Nevada, ‘64. I watched the first two games there, then took a day off, flew back to New York and caught the next three games, and I bet on the Cardinals, and they won it that year, they did, they won it.

No, Stanley was not playing then. Kenny Boyer was playing. That was their big gun, Kenny Boyer. Short and third. Short, no. He was a great player. They had a good team, a real good team. The announcer now was playing then. I forget his name. He announces the World Series now. He was catching for them. What the heck is his name? Tim McCarver. He was with them. He was good. Tim was a good player.
